Manipur Violence: Three Killed, Bodies Placed Outside CM's Residence

Three people were killed in fresh violence in Manipur, with their bodies placed outside the Chief Minister's residence in protest. One of the deceased was identified as Paolen Khongsai, a member of the Kuki community, who was shot dead in Kangpokpi district. This incident followed the killing of three individuals from the Meitei community a day prior. In response to the Kuki man's death, a shutdown was called in Kangpokpi, and life was affected in five districts due to the bandh. Tear gas shells were used during protests outside the CM's residence.
